verdict.rationale: SavvyCal documents automatic creation of unique Zoom rooms for new events, adding Google Meet links to calendar events, and attaching Whereby rooms to invites. Each round-robin host can also set their own meeting location, so bookings get a conference link automatically. The evidence is short feature-page claims only. Missing for 10: any evidence of Microsoft Teams support, any native video option, in-depth setup docs for auto-attaching links per event type, independent or hands-on corroboration.
